title: Scotland Domestic Energy Performance Certificates - Dataset to Q2 2026: row
description: One row of the Scottish Government CSV for 'Domestic Energy Performance Certificates - Dataset to Q2 2026' (https://www.data.gov.scot/dataset/domestic_energy_performance_certificates___dataset_to_q1_2026), as an object of raw string values keyed by the column names in row 1 of the CSV. Row 2 holds descriptive labels, given here as property titles. Element performance fields (walls, roof, floor and so on) may hold several values joined with ' | '.

missing.description: Empty value or the source's missing-value marker.

BUILDING_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: Property_UPRN
BUILDING_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique 10-digit identifier for the property, generated by the SEPCR to enable the EPC lodgement process even where there is no current matching UPRN for the assessed property extents (building or building unit). Not the same as the Unique Property Reference Number available from the One Scotland Gazetteer.

OSG_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: OSG_UPRN
OSG_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique 9-12-digit property reference number assigned to a building by local authority data custodians and recorded centrally on the One Scotland Gazetteer: Energy Performance of Buildings Data England and Wales (opendatacommunities.org).

ADDRESS1.description: First line of the building address

ADDRESS2.description: Second line of the building address

ADDRESS3.title: POST_TOWN
ADDRESS3.description: Third line of the building address. Note that ADDRESS3 is assigned as POST_TOWN

INSPECTION_DATE.title: Date of Assessment
INSPECTION_DATE.description: Date on which assessment of the energy performance of the building was undertaken

TYPE_OF_ASSESSMENT.title: Type of Assessment
TYPE_OF_ASSESSMENT.description: Tool used (SAP, RdSAP) and whether assessment is for new or existing dwelling.

LODGEMENT_DATE.title: Date of Certificate
LODGEMENT_DATE.description: Date on which the data from the energy performance assessment was lodged to the Scottish EPC Register

ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_CURRENT.title: Primary Energy Indicator (kWh/m2/year)
ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_CURRENT.description: Reports Primary Energy - the amount of energy required at source, before conversion and transmission, to meet the calculated energy demand of the dwelling (Units: kWh/m2/year).

TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA.title: Total floor area (m2)
TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA.description: The total floor area of the dwelling. This excludes any unheated ancillary buildings. (Units: m2)

3_YR_ENERGY_COST_CURRENT.title: Total current energy costs over 3 years (£)
3_YR_ENERGY_COST_CURRENT.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for heating, cooling, lighting, and ventilating the building. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

3_YR_ENERGY_SAVINGS_POTENTIAL.title: Potential future savings over 3 years (£)
3_YR_ENERGY_SAVINGS_POTENTIAL.description: Calculation illustrating the energy cost saving that may be achieved if the listed improvement measures are carried out. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY.title: Current energy efficiency rating
CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY.description: Current energy cost rating (EER or 'SAP rating') for the building which is calculated using both the energy efficiency of the building and the cost of fuels used.

CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING.title: Current energy efficiency rating band
CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING.description: Current Energy Efficiency Rating expressed on a Scale of G to A, with A being the highest (best) rating band.

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY.title: Potential Energy Efficiency Rating
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY.description: Potential energy cost rating for the building, after application of the listed improvement measures, which is again calculated using both the energy efficiency of the improved building and the cost of fuels used.

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING.title: Potential energy efficiency rating band
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING.description: Potential Energy Efficiency Rating expressed on a Scale of G to A, with A being the highest (best) rating band.

ENVIRONMENT_IMPACT_CURRENT.title: Current Environmental Impact Rating
ENVIRONMENT_IMPACT_CURRENT.description: Current environmental impact for the building which is calculated using the emissions associated with the energy use of the building.

CURRENT_ENVIRONMENTAL_RATING.title: Current Environmental Impact Rating Band
CURRENT_ENVIRONMENTAL_RATING.description: Current Environmental Impact Rating expressed on a Scale of G to A, with A being the highest (best) rating band.

ENVIRONMENT_IMPACT_POTENTIAL.title: Potential Environmental Impact Rating
ENVIRONMENT_IMPACT_POTENTIAL.description: Potential environmental impact for the building, after application of the listed improvement measures, which is again calculated using the emissions associated with the energy use of the building.

POTENTIAL_ENVIRONMENTAL_RATING.title: Potential Environmental Impact Rating Band
POTENTIAL_ENVIRONMENTAL_RATING.description: Potential Environmental Impact Rating expressed on a Scale of G to A, with A being the highest (best) rating band.

CO2_EMISS_CURR_PER_FLOOR_AREA.title: CO2 Emissions Current Per Floor Area (kg.CO2/m2/yr)
CO2_EMISS_CURR_PER_FLOOR_AREA.description: Annual CO2 equivalent emissions per square metre of floor area (units: kg.CO2e/m2/yr)

IMPROVEMENTS.title: Improvements
IMPROVEMENTS.description: A list of the improvement measures identified as relevant to the building at the date of assessment. These measures are drawn from the list of measures published in Appendix T of the current SAP 2012 October 2013 with RdSAP 19 Dec 2014 specification. Improvement measures are listed sequentially under a single data entry in the following format: 'Description; Typical saving; Energy Rating after improvement; Environmental Rating after improvement; Green Deal eligible.' Each measure reported is separated by a vertical line [ "|" - ASCII (decimal) 124]

WALL_DESCRIPTION.description: Description of the walls (element performance summary). Summary of the performance of this building element, reported in the following format: 'Description; Energy Efficiency Rating; Environmental Efficiency Rating.' Both ratings elements are reported on a scale of 1 to 5 (very poor, poor, average, good, very good). Note: where a dwelling has more than one type of this element, multiple elements can be reported. Each element reported is separated by "|" [ASCII (decimal) 124]

CO2_EMISSIONS_CURRENT.title: Current Emissions (T.CO2/yr)
CO2_EMISSIONS_CURRENT.description: The total annual emissions reduction for the building based upon the calculated energy demand for heating, cooling, lighting, and ventilating the building. (Units: tonnes per year)

CO2_EMISSIONS_POTENTIAL.title: Potential Reduction in Emissions (T.CO2/yr)
CO2_EMISSIONS_POTENTIAL.description: Calculation illustrating the total annual emissions reduction for the building if the identified improvement measures are carried out. (Units: tonnes per year)

HEATING_COST_CURRENT.title: Current heating costs over 3 years (£)
HEATING_COST_CURRENT.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for heating over the stated period. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL.title: Potential heating costs over 3 years (£)
HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for heating over the stated period if recommended improvement measures are carried out. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT.title: Current hot water costs over 3 years (£)
HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for hot water over the stated period. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

HOT_WATER_COST_POTENTIAL.title: Potential hot water costs over 3 years (£)
HOT_WATER_COST_POTENTIAL.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for hot water over the stated period if recommended improvement measures are carried out. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT.title: Current lighting costs over 3 years (£)
LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for lighting over the stated period. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

LIGHTING_COST_POTENTIAL.title: Potential lighting costs over 3 years (£)
LIGHTING_COST_POTENTIAL.description: Calculation illustrating the total energy cost for lighting over the stated period if recommended improvement measures are carried out. Based on standardised occupancy patterns and fuel costs. (Units: £)

ALTERNATIVE_IMPROVEMENTS.title: Alternative Measures 2
ALTERNATIVE_IMPROVEMENTS.description: List of further improvements to the building that can be considered. Note that these measures are not used in calculation of potential ratings or savings (description only). Note: multiple measures can be reported. Each measure reported is separated by a vertical line [ "|" - ASCII (decimal) 124]

LZC_ENERGY_SOURCES.title: LZC Energy Source
LZC_ENERGY_SOURCES.description: Recorded where a low or zero carbon technology (equipment that either generates or otherwise provides energy with no or little resulting emissions) is present in the dwelling. Examples include photovoltaic panels, solar thermal panels, and wind turbines.

SPACE_HEATING_DEMAND.title: Space Heating
SPACE_HEATING_DEMAND.description: Reports the calculated heat demand for space heating in the current dwelling. Based upon the levels of insulation present and how this limits heat loss. (Units: kWh per year)

WATER_HEATING_DEMAND.title: Water Heating
WATER_HEATING_DEMAND.description: Reports the calculated heat demand for provision of hot water in the current dwelling. Based upon the efficiency of the water heating system. (Units: kWh per year)

IMPACT_LOFT_INSULATION.title: Impact Of Loft Insulation
IMPACT_LOFT_INSULATION.description: (if applicable) Reports the potential reduction in calculated heat demand for space heating if the dwelling loft is insulated. (Units: kWh per year)

IMPACT_CAVITY_WALL_INSULATION.title: Impact Of Cavity Wall Insulation
IMPACT_CAVITY_WALL_INSULATION.description: (if applicable) Reports the potential reduction in calculated heat demand for space heating if the dwelling cavity walls are insulated. (Units: kWh per year)

IMPACT_SOLID_WALL_INSULATION.title: Impact Of Solid Wall Insulation
IMPACT_SOLID_WALL_INSULATION.description: (if applicable) Reports the potential reduction in calculated heat demand for space heating if external or internal insulation applied to the dwelling walls. (Units: kWh per year)

ADDENDUM_TEXT.title: Addendum Text
ADDENDUM_TEXT.description: Used to record a range of specific observations about the dwelling construction that are relevant to the assessment. Current valid options are listed in Section S15 in Appendix S of the current SAP 2012 October 2013 with RdSAP 19 Dec 2014 specification.

FLOOR_HEIGHT.title: Part 1 Floor 0 Room Height
FLOOR_HEIGHT.description: Average height of the lowest storey of the dwelling (Units: m)

DATA_ZONE.title: Data Zone
DATA_ZONE.description: Data Zone code and name - Data zones are the key geography for the dissemination of small area statistics in Scotland.

ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_POTENTIAL.title: Energy Consumption Potential
ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_POTENTIAL.description: Reports Primary Energy - the amount of energy required at source, before conversion and transmission, to meet the calculated energy demand of the dwelling, if recommended improvement measures are carried out (Units: kWh/m2/year).

EXTENSION_COUNT.title: Extensions Count
EXTENSION_COUNT.description: The number of extensions added to the property. Between 0 and 4 can be reported.

FIXED_LIGHTING_OUTLETS_COUNT.title: Fixed Lighting Outlets Count
FIXED_LIGHTING_OUTLETS_COUNT.description: The number of fixed lighting outlets in the dwelling.

LOW_ENERGY_FIXED_LIGHT_COUNT.title: Low Energy Lighting Outlets Count
LOW_ENERGY_FIXED_LIGHT_COUNT.description: The number of low-energy fixed lighting outlets.

LOW_ENERGY_LIGHTING.title: Low Energy Lighting %
LOW_ENERGY_LIGHTING.description: The percentage of low energy lighting present in the property as a percentage of the total fixed lights in the property. 0% indicates that no low-energy lighting is present.

FLOOR_LEVEL.title: Flat Level
FLOOR_LEVEL.description: Floor level relative to the lowest level of the building

FLAT_TOP_STOREY.title: Flat Location
FLAT_TOP_STOREY.description: The number of storeys in the flatted block.

GLAZED_AREA.title: Glazed Area
GLAZED_AREA.description: Ranged estimate of the total glazed area of the Habitable Area: 0 - New dwelling 1 - Typical glazing 2 - More than typical 3 - Less than typical 4 - Much more than typical 5 - Much less than typical

NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS.title: Habitable Room Count
NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS.description: Habitable rooms include any living room, sitting room, dining room, bedroom, study and similar. Excludes any room used solely as a kitchen, utility room, sanitary accommodation and any hallway, stairs, or landing; and also any conservatory or room without a window.

HEAT_LOSS_CORRIDOOR.title: Heat Loss Corridor
HEAT_LOSS_CORRIDOOR.description: Flats and maisonettes only. Indicates that the flat contains a corridor through which heat is lost. Heat loss corridor, one of: no corridor; heated corridor; unheated corridor

NUMBER_HEATED_ROOMS.title: Heated Room Count
NUMBER_HEATED_ROOMS.description: The number of heated habitable rooms in the property.

LOCAL_AUTHORITY_LABEL.title: Local Authority
LOCAL_AUTHORITY_LABEL.description: The name of the local authority area in which the building is located.

MAINS_GAS_FLAG.title: Main Gas
MAINS_GAS_FLAG.description: Whether mains gas is available. Yes means that there is a gas meter or a gas-burning appliance in the dwelling

MAIN_HEATING_CATEGORY.title: Main Heating 1 Category
MAIN_HEATING_CATEGORY.description: Reports the type of main heating system present in the dwelling. Lists both heat source and heat emitters (e.g. gas boiler and radiators).

MAIN_FUEL.title: Main Heating 1 Fuel Type
MAIN_FUEL.description: Reports the fuel type used by the main heating system present in the dwelling.

MAIN_HEATING_CONTROLS.title: Main Heating 1 Control
MAIN_HEATING_CONTROLS.description: Type of main heating controls. Includes both main heating systems if there are two.

MECHANICAL_VENTILATION.title: Mechanical Ventilation
MECHANICAL_VENTILATION.description: Identifies the type of mechanical ventilation the property has.

ENERGY_TARIFF.title: Meter Type
ENERGY_TARIFF.description: Type of electricity tariff for the property (by meter type), e.g. single.

MULTI_GLAZE_PROPORTION.title: Multiple Glazed Proportion
MULTI_GLAZE_PROPORTION.description: The estimated banded range (e.g. 0% - 10%) of the total glazed area of the Property that is multiple glazed.

GLAZED_TYPE.title: Multiple Glazing Type
GLAZED_TYPE.description: The type of glazing. From British Fenestration Rating Council or manufacturer declaration, one of; single; double; triple.

NUMBER_OPEN_FIREPLACES.title: Open Fireplaces Count
NUMBER_OPEN_FIREPLACES.description: The number of Open Fireplaces in the Property. An Open Fireplace is a fireplace that still allows air to pass between the inside of the Property and the outside.

PHOTO_SUPPLY.title: Photovoltaic Supply
PHOTO_SUPPLY.description: Photovoltaic area as a percentage of total roof area. 0% indicates that a Photovoltaic Supply is not present in the property. Note: multiple arrays can be reported. Each array reported is separated by a vertical line [ "|" - ASCII (decimal) 124]

SOLAR_WATER_HEATING_FLAG.title: Solar Water Heating
SOLAR_WATER_HEATING_FLAG.description: Indicates whether the water heating in the property is served by solar thermal panels.

TENURE.title: Tenure
TENURE.description: Describes the tenure type of the property. One of: Owner- occupied; Rented (social); Rented (private); Unknown

TRANSACTION_TYPE.title: Transaction Type
TRANSACTION_TYPE.description: Type of transaction or purpose that triggered EPC assessment. One of: - new dwelling; marketed sale; non-marketed sale; rental; not sale or rental; assessment for Green Deal; following Green Deal; FIT application; RHI application; ECO assessment; none of the above. Where the reason for the assessment is unknown by the energy assessor the transaction type will be recorded as 'none of the above'.

UNHEATED_CORRIDOR_LENGTH.title: Unheated Corridor Length
UNHEATED_CORRIDOR_LENGTH.description: The total length of unheated corridor in the flat. Only populated if flat or maisonette contains unheated corridor. If unheated corridor, length of sheltered wall (m2).

CONSTITUENCY.title: Ward Code
CONSTITUENCY.description: Code for Parliamentary constituency in which the building is located. Scottish area defined as 'Ward', not 'constituency'

CONSTITUENCY_LABEL.title: Ward Name
CONSTITUENCY_LABEL.description: Name of Parliamentary constituency in which the building is located. Scottish area defined as 'Ward', not 'constituency'

WIND_TURBINE_COUNT.title: Wind Turbines Count
WIND_TURBINE_COUNT.description: Number of wind turbines; 0 if none.

BUILT_FORM.title: Built Form
BUILT_FORM.description: The building type of the Property e.g. Detached, Semi-Detached, Terrace etc. Together with the Property Type, the Build Form produces a structured description of the property

PROPERTY_TYPE.title: Property Type
PROPERTY_TYPE.description: Describes the type of property such as House, Flat, Maisonette etc. This is the type differentiator for dwellings.

DATA_ZONE_2011.title: Data Zone 2011
DATA_ZONE_2011.description: Data zones from 2011, representing small areas across Scotland of around 500 - 1,000 household residents.

CREATED_AT.title: Lodgement Date
CREATED_AT.description: The date and time that the certificate was lodged on the register.

REPORT_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: RRN
REPORT_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique, auto-generated number produced on the lodgement of an EPC to the SEPCR.
